This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Harvest" />

==Biology and appearance==
This large [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their wide features, as well as two sets of two horns, one pointing up and one curving downwards.<ref name="Harvest" />

==Species in the galaxy==
In [[4 BBY]], a member of this species was in attendance at the wedding ceremony of [[Leida Mothma]] and [[Stekan Sculdun]] at the [[Mothma Estate]] on the [[planet]] [[Chandrila]].<ref name="Harvest" /> A year later, another member of this species attended a gathering hosted by [[Davo Sculdun]].<ref name="What a Festive Evening">{{Andor|What a Festive Evening}}</ref> Yet another year later, a member of this species was present at the [[Imperial Senate Building]] on the planet [[Coruscant]].<ref name="Messenger">{{Andor|Messenger}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Unidentified-Four-Horned-Species-Silicone-Bust-Mask.png|right|200px|thumb|One of the silicone bust masks created by Sophie Rechtberger]]
The species made their debut in the [[Harvest|third episode]] of the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'',<ref name="Harvest" /> directed by [[Ariel Kleiman]] and aired on [[April 22]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref> This species was designed by concept artist and sculptor [[Ivan Manzella]],<ref name="Manzella">{{WebCite|url=https://www.krop.com/ivanmanzella|text=Ivan Manzella Creature & Character Designs|author=[[Ivan Manzella|Manzella, Ivan]]|work=[https://www.krop.com Krop]|archivedate=20250715083228}}</ref> while the original silicon bust mask used for this species in the series were modeled by [[Sophie Rechtberger]].<ref name="Rechtberger">{{WebCite|url=http://sophierechtberger.com/silicone-busts-masks|text=SOPHIE RECHTBERGER|work=[http://sophierechtberger.com SOPHIE RECHTBERGER]|archivedate=20250518022123}}</ref>
